[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] maintained her own private '''quarters''' in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the galaxy-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

When the fugitive [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was on the run for a crime that she did not commit in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], Offee kept in contact with her several times and provided her with information that Tano would use to hunt for proof of her innocence

Later, during Ahsoka's trial in the [[Republic military base]], Barriss concealed her newly acquired [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|lightsabers]]. Believing her to be a traitor, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered her quarters and took [[Barriss Offee's lightsaber|her lightsaber]] in order to try and restrain her. However, she managed to escape before Anakin could stop her. She deflected the sudden strikes from Anakin's lightsabers by kinetically pulling [[Asajj Ventress's lightsaber|Ventress's lightsabers]] that she had stolen out of a pot. The battle soon continued out of the quarters to the hall, thus leaving her quarters forever.

==Behind the scenes==
Barriss Offee's quarters, as designed by [[David Le Merrer]], are marked by the same black diamond pattern facial marks of Offee's face.<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-wrong-jedi-trivia-gallery|text="The Wrong Jedi" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref>
